name: Andrus
source:
A lizardman who understands human language. He is a friend and also a member of Gatea. He came with Forneus as his subordinate to assist him. Although he is not afraid of using underhand method, he fights head-on with worthy opponents. He sets his eyes on Sacred Noire and aim to make her his.

「I am not vulgar but noble!」
